# Recon Analytics 2026-10 AI 用户切换工具

每月约 6% 的 AI 用户换主力工具；重度用户换得更多；换工具的人付费比例更高。

- 信源等级：B（AI 定级）
- 立场和局限：研究机构的在线追踪调查（AI Pulse），13 个周波次截至 2026-09-18。

## 论断

- 「Of 31,569 AI users asked, 18% said they had changed their primary AI tool in the previous three months, an average of 6% a month.」— 位置：AI tool switching runs at about 6% of AI users a month 一节 ^c1
- 「Heavy users drive the rate. People who use AI several times a day switch at 9% a month; those who use it a few times a month switch at 3%.」— 位置：同一节 ^c2
- 「Most AI users never face that choice, because they already use more than one tool.」— 位置：导言第 3 段 ^c3

## 抓取原文


> 公开版只收录上面"论断"里的原文摘句，全文请看来源链接。

Of 31,569 AI users asked, 18% said they had changed their primary AI tool in the previous three months, an average of 6% a month.

Heavy users drive the rate. People who use AI several times a day switch at 9% a month; those who use it a few times a month switch at 3%.

Most AI users never face that choice, because they already use more than one tool.
